blocks.title: SMILE Scheme (Support for Marginalised Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise)
blocks.summary: To provide comprehensive welfare, rehabilitation, skill development, medical care, and economic reintegration for transgender persons and persons engaged in the act of begging.

rows: ₹365 Cr total outlay (₹265 Cr Transgender, ₹100 Cr Begging).
Garima Greh Shelter Homes & PM-DAKSH Livelihood Support
Garima Greh shelter homes; Ayushman Bharat ₹5L TG health package.
Pilot in 75 major municipal corporations for rescue and skill training.
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, National Institute of Social Defence (NISD), State Governments, and Community Based Organizations.

items: **Target Beneficiaries:** Transgender persons holding Transgender Certificate/ID from National Portal for Transgender Persons, and individuals/families engaged in begging.

**Eligibility Criteria:** Transgender persons holding Transgender Certificate/ID card issued through the National Portal for Transgender Persons (transgender.dosje.gov.in), and destitute individuals identified through municipal surveys.

1. Central Sector Scheme for Comprehensive Rehabilitation for Welfare of Transgender Persons (scholarships, skill training via PM-DAKSH, Garima Greh shelter homes, gender-affirming healthcare up to ₹5 Lakh under Ayushman Bharat TG package).
2. Central Sector Scheme for Comprehensive Rehabilitation of persons engaged in the act of Begging (pilot in 30+ major cities for rescue, shelter, medical aid, education, and livelihood generation).
Garima Greh: Community-based residential shelter homes offering food, clothing, and recreation.
Exam Trap: SMILE encompasses TWO distinct target groups: Transgenders AND Persons engaged in Begging.
Ayushman Bharat package: Dedicated ₹5 Lakh health cover for transgender persons (TG Card) covering gender affirmation procedures.
Issuing Portal: Transgender certificates/cards are issued via the National Portal for Transgender Persons (transgender.dosje.gov.in).
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Official Launch Notification (socialjustice.gov.in)
PIB Delhi, "Union Minister Launches SMILE Scheme for Marginalized Groups" (12-Feb-2022)
